ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ الَّذِيْنَ رَبَطُوْا قُلُوْبَهُمْ بِمَحَبَّتِهِ كُلَّ الْاِرْتِبَاطِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Alladhīna rabaṭū qulūba hum bi maḥabbati hī kulla ‘l-irtibāṭ.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family whose hearts connected to his love at every connection!

ar: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ عَدَدَ كُلِّ مَحْفُوْظٍ وَحَافِظٍ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, `Adada kulli maḥfūẓin wa ḥāfiẓ.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family the number of everything protected and every protector!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ عَدَدَ كُلِّ مَوْعُوْظٍ وَ وَاعِظٍ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī,  `Adada kulli maw`ūẓin wa wā`iẓ.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family the number of everyone admonished and every admonisher!
